protocol.paper_disjoint_ablation_definition: Protocol-corrected ablation: CP calibration first, AFC training second, and BiP-regressor training last, with no overlap.

paired_protocol_audit.interpretation: AFC/train/calibration/test indices must be identical across the paired lanes. If test bifurcations differ, the split effect is confounded by author-model refit randomness because the RF subset cannot change the test conformal sets.
